content: धारण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [धृ-णिच्-ल्युट्] Holding, bearing, carrying, preserving, sustaining, protecting, having, assuming, <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-णौ@} (<ab>du.</ab>) The two female breasts. .{@-णम्@} .²1 The act of holding, bearing, supporting, preserving or keeping back. .²2 Possessing, possession. .²3 Observing; holding fast. .²4 Retaining in the memory; ग्रहणधारणपटुर्बालकः. .²5 Being indebted (to any one). .²6 Steady abstraction of the mind. .²7 Keeping, maintaining. .²8 Restraining. .²9 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Pronouncing imperfectly. .{@-णी@} .²1 A row or line. .²2 A vein or tubular vessel. .²3 Steadiness. .²4 A mystical verse or charm to assuage pain.
